Let me pick six strong, flexible Pokémon: Garchomp, Kingambit, Gholdengo, Rotom-Wash, Corviknight, Heatran? Heatran not in list. Let's check: legal list includes Garchomp, Kingambit, Gholdengo, Rotom-Wash, Corviknight, Slowking-Galar, Toxapex, Dragonite, Weavile, Annihilape, Glimmora, Pelipper... 

Pick a balanced team: Garchomp (offense/rocks), Kingambit (endgame), Gholdengo (spinblock/special), Rotom-Wash (pivot), Corviknight (physical wall/defog), Slowking-Galar or Toxapex (special wall). Since bring 3 of 6, need versatile picks.

I'll go: Garchomp, Kingambit, Gholdengo, Rotom-Wash, Corviknight, Slowking-Galar.

Garchomp becomes the hazard-setting breaker: Mega Garchompite gives it massive attack, Stealth Rock supports the whole bring-3 format, Swords Dance breaks, and Stone Edge covers the Flying/Steel switch-ins (Corviknight) that wall EQ. Gholdengo is the special attacker and spinblocker — Nasty Plot + Make It Rain/Shadow Ball with Recover and Life Orb. Rotom-Wash and Corviknight are the two pivots (Volt Switch / U-turn plus status spreading), while Slowking-Galar pivots with Chillary Reception + Regenerator and fires off Future Sight into Sludge Bomb. Items are spread so no two overlap, and each Pokémon gets 32 in its two most important stats plus 2 filler for 66 total.

Nature Bold/Impish.

Actually U-turn for pivoting; but Body Press + Iron Defense + Roost + U-turn. Good.

Chople Berry helps vs Fighting Sucker Punch users (Kingambit itself, Fighting attacks). Slowking-Galar's Poison resists Fighting anyway (Poison resists Fighting). Chople for knock off? Poison/Psychic weak to Ground, Ghost, Dark, Psychic. Shuca Berry (Ground) — Gholdengo has same weakness. Kasib Berry (Ghost), Colbur Berry (Dark) — Colbur helps take a Knock Off from Kingambit. Let's give Slowking Colbur Berry? Or Lum Berry. Hmm, Chilly Reception + Future Sight + Sludge Bomb + Slack Off with Twisted Spoon is solid. Actually the plan says Slowking is a defensive pivot + special attacker. I'll go: Chilly Reception, Future Sight, Sludge Bomb, Flamethrower (hits Steel that block Poison — Corviknight/Steel types). With Regenerator. Item: Twisted Spoon boosts Future Sight, Psychic, Eerie Spell. But Flamethrower/Sludge Bomb not boosted. Alternatively Expert Belt boosts all super-effective moves. I'd pick Expert Belt maybe. Hmm.

1. Garchomp @ Garchompite
2. Kingambit @ Black Glasses (boosts Sucker Punch + Kowtow Cleave)
3. Gholdengo @ Life Orb
4. Rotom-Wash @ Leftovers
5. Corviknight @ Sitrus Berry

Twisted Spoon boosts Future Sight (1.2x) — good for the Future Sight + Sludge Bomb combos. I'll take Twisted Spoon.

Garchomp (Mega): Atk and Speed matter. 32 Atk / 32 Spe / 2 HP = 66. Jolly? Mega Garchomp speed 102 at level 50... At level 50, base 102 Spe with Jolly + 32 EVs. Hmm, nature: Jolly for outspeeding more. Or Adamant for power. Mega Chomp is slow; with 32 EVs at level 50 the speed is roughly: base 102 at lvl 50 → (2*102+31+0)*50/100+5 = (204+31)*0.5+5 = 117.5+5 = 122.5 → 122, + nature 1.1 = ~134. Jolly ~134. That outspeeds a lot of unboosted middling stuff. I'll go Jolly.

Actually, wait: at level 50, IVs 31. Let me just do Jolly with 32 Spe.

Kingambit: Supreme Overlord, 32 Atk / 32 Spe? Kingambit is slow; priority Sucker Punch is the point. Maybe 32 HP / 32 Atk / 2 SpD. Adamant. Actually with 32 Spe EVs and Adamant, Kingambit speed at 50: base 50 → (100+31+0)*0.5+5 = 65.5+5=70.5 → 70, Adamant 0.9 = 63. Not much. Jolly: 70*1.1=77 — that could matter for speed creeping other slow things (base 50-60). Hmm, in BSS level 50 Kingambit usually runs Adamant. But with only 32 EVs, outspeeding other Kingambits matters less (Sucker wars). I'll do Adamant, 32 HP / 32 Atk / 2 SpD.

Hmm, but "late-game cleaner" — Kingambit with Supreme Overlord + Sucker Punch cleans. Adamant fine.

Gholdengo: 32 SpA / 32 Spe / 2 HP? Timid for speed. Base 84 Spe at 50: (168+31)*0.5+5 = 99.5+5 = 104.5 → 104, Timid → 114. Modest → 104*0.9=93. Timid to outspeed more. With Life Orb and Nasty Plot, Modest might be better for power. Hmm. In Bring-6-pick-3, speed tiers matter. I'll go Timid with 32 Spe.

Or put into SpD... Rotom's weakness: only Ground (Levitate), so it takes neutral from most. Bold/Physically defensive is standard. I'll do Bold 32 HP / 32 Def / 2 SpD.

Corviknight: Bold/Impish. Body Press benefits from Def. Impish doesn't affect Body Press (uses Def, unaffected by nature's Atk). Bold increases Def by 10%, lowers SpA (irrelevant). So Bold. 32 HP / 32 Def / 2 SpD.

Slowking-Galar: Regenerator, Calm nature, 32 HP / 32 SpD / 2 SpA. Special wall pivot. Good.

Scale Shot gives speed boost for cleaning (late-game cleaner role is Kingambit though; Garchomp is hazard setter/breaker). Options: Stealth Rock, Earthquake, Swords Dance, Stone Edge — Stone Edge hits Corviknight/Tornadus. Or Scale Shot. Since Garchomp can't hit Corviknight with EQ (Flying/Steel immune to Ground), Stone Edge is needed. But Mega Chomp gets Sand Force... I'll pick Stone Edge for coverage. Hmm, Scale Shot is nice for sweeping. Given bring-3, coverage matters more. Actually consider Fire Blast for Corviknight too. I'll go: Stealth Rock, Swords Dance, Earthquake, Stone Edge.

If opponent has Garchomp rocks, we could Defog with Corviknight. But Body Press + Iron Defense is a win condition. I'll skip Defog; team has3 immunities-ish (Corviknight, Gholdengo, Rotom Levitate for rocks).

Chilly Reception always works unless Imprison/TAUNT? Taunt doesn't block Chilly Reception? Chilly Reception is a status move — Taunt blocks it. Hmm. Still, Regenerator + Chilly Reception pivoting is standard. Sludge Bomb for STAB, Flamethrower to hit Steel switch-ins (Corviknight, Kingambit), Future Sight for the classic Future Sight + Sludge Bomb combo. Missing recovery when staying in — Regenerator covers.

Also consider Yawn over Flamethrower. I'll keep Flamethrower.
